The series diagnosis explicitly recommends a selective combination, and the top model (CWT_catboost) dominates the ranking in two of the three windows.  Its per‑window errors are lower or comparable to the weighted and mean strategies, and the negative SMAPE indicates superior performance.  Given the strong trend and limited seasonal structure, a single well‑performing model is likely to generalize well to the blind test window.
